title: fix(console): a list-only object's rows no longer open a record page that always fails
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4wiWvmgdL7tUCZR1o12MVF)_

Fixes #33219

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象若声明的数据 API 不提供单条读取（`enable.apiMethods` 里没有 `get`，例如 Setup 里的「SCIM 连接凭据」只开 `list`），控制台不再为它打开记录详情：点行、Cmd/Ctrl 点行都不打开任何东西，名称单元格不再带记录链接、也不画「以整页打开」↗，`?recordId=` 链接不再弹出抽屉。对象列表、对象数据页、界面列表页同此；指向这类对象的关联列表行、查找值与记录链接也不再跳转。行菜单（`list_item` 动作，如「撤销凭据」）不变。
- 为什么改：详情页用 `get` 读记录，这类对象永远答 `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`，用户点进去只看到「无法加载此记录」和一个永远不会成功的重试。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台 app-shell 的打开记录判断；判断读的是服务器已经在 `/me/permissions` 下发的 `apiOperations`，不新增请求，不读原始 `apiMethods`，不改服务端、不改 `platform-objects`、不加门禁。没有该集合的对象（未收窄、旧服务端、权限未加载）照旧打开。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`（`recordServed` 把模式定为 `none`、拦住修饰键点击与 `?recordId=` 同步）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordReadServed.ts`（唯一判断）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`（`routableObjectNames` 排除不可单读的对象）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listOnlyRecordPage-33219.test.tsx`，预期 9 个用例全绿；或在 staging 的 Setup → SCIM 连接凭据点任意一行，预期什么都不打开，行菜单里仍有「撤销凭据」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`utils/recordReadServed.ts`** (new, `@object-ui/app-shell`): `servesRecordRead(objectName, perms)` is the one verdict. It answers `false` only when the server's effective operation set for the object (`/me/permissions` `apiOperations`, read through `usePermissions().getObjectApiOperations`) is an array without `get`. No set (an unrestricted object, an old backend, no provider, the answer still loading) answers `true`, the same default-allow every other affordance keeps. It never reads the raw `apiMethods`, and it makes no request.
- **The object list (`objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, the hook behind `ObjectView`)**: for an object that does not serve `get`, the record navigation resolves to the spec's existing `none` mode on every viewport, whatever the view or object authored. `ObjectView` already reads that mode, so the Display menu's Open records section and the row's ↗ are not drawn. The row click handler returns before its modifier branch, so a Cmd/Ctrl/middle click opens no tab. A `?recordId=` link neither opens the drawer nor (on a phone) redirects to the record page, and the drawer root stays `null`. The record links the list publishes get the caller's permissions, so the listed object's own record answers no href and `openRecord` does nothing.
- **`objectViewRecordLinks.ts`**: `ListRecordRoutes` carries `perms`; the listed object's own href and `openRecord` are gated by the same verdict, and other objects go through `routableObjectNames` below.
- **`RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx`**: `routableObjectNames(objects, perms)` leaves out an object that does not serve `get`. That set already decides whether a record path exists, so on a record page a related-list row of such an object opens nothing, and a lookup value pointing at one renders as the plain value (the documented `null` answer). `ScreenView`'s record link passes the caller's permissions to the same function.
- **`ObjectDataPage.tsx`** and **`InterfaceListPage.tsx`**: each routes its own row clicks and `?recordId=` drawer, so each reads the same verdict. The data page's click handler returns, and the interface page resolves its `recordAction` to `none`. Neither opens a drawer for a `?recordId=` link.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33219-list-only-row-no-record-page.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` (the published package whose `dist` ships app-shell) patch, with both declaration lines.
- Not changed: `packages/platform-objects/**` (the credential object's `record_header` placement of `revoke_scim_credential` stays the object author's call), any spec key, lint or gate, `@object-ui/core`'s published exports, and any server code.

## Tests

- **`ObjectView.listOnlyRecordPage-33219.test.tsx`** (new), driven through the real `ObjectView`, the real `ListView` grid and the real `MePermissionsProvider` holding a `/me/permissions` answer. Every case is one differential: the same object and rows, only `apiOperations` differs (`['list','aggregate','export','search']`, the shape a list-only object is served).
  - Object list: a row click leaves the URL without `?recordId=`, draws no dialog, stays on the list and reads no record; a Cmd-click on a non-link cell calls no `window.open`, and the row holds no `a[href]`; the row draws no `record-open-as-page` ↗; a `?recordId=c1` link draws no dialog and calls no `findOne`; the row menu still lists `Revoke` (a `list_item` + `record_header` action, the credential's shape).
  - Data page (`/:objectName/data`): a row click and a Cmd-click open nothing; a `?recordId=` link draws no dialog and reads no record.
  - CONTROLS: the same object with no `apiOperations` annotation draws the ↗ and a record anchor, its Cmd-click calls `window.open` once, and a row click writes `?recordId=c1` and opens the drawer, on both pages.
- **`ObjectView.listRecordHref.test.ts`** (the existing harness for `listRecordActionsValue`): new top-level describe, 3 cases. The listed list-only object answers no href and `openRecord` does nothing; a list-only object linked from another list likewise; CONTROL: an object with no set, or one served `get`, keeps its href.
- **Ablation** on head `5d236b06` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `servesRecordRead`'s verdict line replaced by `return true` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `04bd1e17` to `2c99807c`). Result: 8 of 30 red, every list-only case on both pages and in the href harness; the controls, the row-menu case and the pre-existing href cases stay green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD (`04bd1e17`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. The ui vitest config aliases `@object-ui/*` to source and app-shell's tests import it by relative path, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance 1** (no error page): met by not navigating, the first of the card's two options. No read-only drawer built from the row's fields was added: it would need a new surface and new copy, and the ruling allows either.
- **Acceptance 2** (Revoke from the row menu): the row menu is untouched and pinned to still list the `list_item` action.
- **Acceptance 3** (a test pins that a list-only row is not navigated to a `get` page): the new file above, ablated.
- **Surfaces checked.** Gated: the console object list (grid, and kanban / calendar / gantt / gallery, which all hand their row click to the same host handler through `ListView`'s `onRowClick`), the bare data page, interface list pages, a record page's related-list rows and lookup values (through `routableObjectNames`), the list page's links to other objects, and `ScreenView`'s record link. Pinned by rendered tests: the object list and the data page. Interface list pages and related lists are covered by the shared verdict and read from the code, not by a rendered pin of their own. Left as is: `expandedRecordPath` (the drawer stack's 「Open as full page」), which only runs for a level already open, and no level of such an object can now be opened.
- **What still looks clickable.** On such an object's row, the auto-linked first cell is still drawn as a `role="link"` span (now without an href) and the grid's right-click menu still offers an Open item. Both do nothing. The grid draws them whenever a host passes `onRowClick`, without asking whether anything opens; a view that authors `navigation.mode: 'none'` gets the same face today. This is noted for the seat, not filed, and is not changed here (plugin-grid behaviour for every `none` row).
- **How the console learns `apiMethods`.** No new fetch: the server already annotates every narrowed object's `/me/permissions` entry with `apiOperations` (`annotateEffectiveApiOperations` in `@objectstack/core`), and a list-only object's set is `list` and what derives from it, without `get`.

## Verification

Run on head `5d236b06` (base `d4fbb4db`) unless stated. The two later commits change no source: `d25bb415` adds `@object-ui/console` to the changeset front matter, and `8f09d414` adds the module-top lint import to the two test files. On `8f09d414` the two pin files were rerun (Test Files 2 passed, Tests 30 passed) and every derived gate was rerun.

<details><summary>Build, tests, type-check and lint</summary>

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/spec...' … build` (spec, formula, client, lint, sdui-parser, client-react closures) under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listOnlyRecordPage-33219.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listRecordHref.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 30 passed (30).
- Affected suites, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `ObjectView.*`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge*`, `InterfaceListPage.*`, `ObjectDataPage.*`, `ScreenView*`, `recordDrawer*`, `objectViewRecord*` under `packages/app-shell/src/views/`: Test Files 110 passed (110), Tests 992 passed (992).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both the source and the test tsconfig): exit 0.
- eslint on the nine changed app-shell files: 0 errors (warnings are the files' existing ones). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 36 families on this diff, and on the final head `8f09d414` all 36 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation with exit codes recorded: 36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero). On the first pass (head `5d236b06`) `pnpm check:test-source-alias` exited 1: both edited ObjectView test files reach a dynamic `import('@objectstack/lint')` through `ObjectView`, so each now pays that load at collection with a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint';`, the gate's own prescription and the sibling ObjectView tests' form. Rerun: exit 0. Changed lines: 564 (530 added, 34 removed), under the 3,000 threshold.
